title: Publish dialog, after the click
summary: The Publish 1.9.0 dialog right after the click, over the dimmed Channels page: each channel's row turns into its own progress (Polaris Key done, Google Play sending, the App Store failed with what went wrong, how to fix it and a Retry for that channel only), because partial success is the realistic outcome of one click to three stores.
compare: After Publish the dialog stays open and its title says what is happening ('Publishing 1.9.0'); the meta line names the promotion and who started it.

Each channel from the click is one row with its own state in words: Done (status text with a tick), Sending (spinner, muted text) or Failed (danger mark and status). The eyebrow counts them ('1 done · 1 sending · 1 failed').

A failed row says in one sentence what went wrong and how to fix it, in the store's terms ('Apple didn't accept the submission: build 214 has no export compliance answers. Answer them in App Store Connect, then retry.'), with Retry for that channel only and a link to the store's own page. Nothing that already succeeded is sent again.
A done row says what happened and what follows (Polaris Key: 10% now, everyone by Oct 10; Scoop and Obtainium follow it).
No click needed stays one line with Show, as before the click.
The footer says closing doesn't stop anything and Close is the only button; there is no primary while a channel is still sending or has failed.

When every channel succeeds the dialog closes by itself to one success toast in the past tense ('Published 1.9.0 to 3 channels'); when any failed it stays open like this, and closing it leaves the failed channel's row on Channels in Attention with the same sentence and Retry.
The header and footer stay in view and the body scrolls (capped to the viewport); on phone the dialog is a full-height sheet with the footer at the bottom and each row's state under its text.
